title: Build Quarantine with nine distinct bosses, illustrated items and individual themes
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Implements the offline/Colyseus loop for Soldier, Medic and Heavy against nine distinct bosses. Quarantine draws four nonrepeating regular encounters and a route finale; all six collision layouts support actual opening-map selection and subsequent route rotation. Four classes, 51 identities, other timed routes and full final environment/action art remain in development.

Adds Tollkeeper reflected wheel paths, Chain Marshal independently breakable anchors and sweeping chains, Gate Widow rotating solid shutters with matching prediction, and Black Ambulance patrol/charge/exposed-driver windows. These join the real Constable, Warden, Courier, Ratcatcher and Clerk mechanics. Protocol 7 adds map state and identities; bounded local v4/5/6 Practice saves migrate, while obsolete online clients/signed saves remain rejected.

Connects 71 item illustrations, five prior upgrade paintings, 64 drawn encounter/minion frames, the prior 27 Warden and 32 Heavy frames, plus a painted wheel prop. Native PNGs, exact imagegen prompts and independent RGBA/pixel/hash audits are preserved. Nine separately scored original boss themes use crossfades and warning ducking; source scores, synthesis and PCM masters are editable. Full motion and listening acceptance remain open.

Validation: 133 rules/WebSocket/HTTP/SQL tests, strict TypeScript, authored-content/fifteen-locale checks and production build pass. New network tests verify all four civic signatures, selected arena, damaged anchors and active shutters. Prior short isolated performance evidence remains limited to its recorded source/fixtures; no new rendered, fifty-player, WAN/free-host or endurance acceptance is claimed.

Keep draft and main protected. Recovery foundations remain locally tested and disabled in normal execution; durable rankings, full profiles and Windows/LAN release are unfinished. Public hosting remains the earlier protocol-4 Site under another account and is not redeployed by source/Wiki pushes. Work continues through the authorized full-game scope.
